_description: Full appointment scenario — config settings + form payload in one file. _config holds test parameters (target patient, duration defaults). _fields holds the actual form data with DYNAMIC placeholders.

_config._comment_dynamicDateTime: Optional: override auto-generated values. Set to null or omit to use today/now defaults.
_config._comment_defaultDurationMinutes: Used to calculate endTime when startTime is provided but endTime is not (unless both are null).

_fields.notes: Test notes for the appointment. This field can be left empty or populated with any text.
